title: power supply firm aggreko files us ipo 2026 08 24
text:
Aug 24 (Reuters) - Aggreko has filed for a U.S. initial public offering, the ​power supply company said on Monday, as it looks to tap ‌investor appetite for energy infrastructure providers due to growing electricity demand.
The company intends to list its ordinary shares on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "AGKO", ​but did not disclose the number of shares to be offered ​or the proposed price range.
Aggreko's filing with the U.S. Securities ⁠and Exchange Commission comes as investor interest in the sector has soared ​on rising electricity demand and higher spending on power infrastructure, partly due to ​an AI-driven data center boom.

 went public through traditional IPOs this year.
Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan and BofA Securities are serving as joint lead bookrunning managers ​for Aggreko's offering, while Barclays and Morgan Stanley will be bookrunning managers.
The ​Glasgow-headquartered company's revenue grew 28% to about $1.92 billion for the six months ended July 4, helped ‌by ⁠strong demand from data centers and other power-intensive industries.
The company also recorded a profit from continuing operations of $80 million, compared with a loss of $196 million in the year-ago period.
For the year ended January 3, data center-related revenue nearly ​doubled to $391 million, ​according to the ⁠filing.
Aggreko said it had $6 billion in secured net revenue as of July 2026, providing substantial visibility over its future ​performance.
The company, which was taken private in 2021 by ​investment firms ⁠TDR Capital and I Squared Capital, provides temporary power generation, cooling and energy solutions to customers across industries such as utilities, mining, manufacturing and data centers.
The power company operates in ⁠more ​than 80 countries, serves over 14,000 customers ​globally and has about 8,000 employees. It also has more than 17 gigawatts of capacity available across its ​fleet.
